stories.headline_de: Australisches Museum gibt Rapa-Nui-Überreste zurück

stories.headline_de: Verkauf des Glasgow-Kunstarchivs stößt auf Kritik

stories.headline_de: Museen wechseln von Wettbewerb zu Gemeinschaftskäufen

stories.headline_de: Fra Angelicos Altarbild kehrt nach Restaurierung zurück
stories.summary_en: The friar-artist's earliest surviving altarpiece has undergone repair and cleaning, revealing a hidden throne. The work was later updated by Lorenzo di Credi.

stories.summary_en: Valerie Hillings has been appointed inaugural director of Guggenheim Abu Dhabi. She previously worked at the institution between 2009 and 2018.
